display_long_description:
Welding OHS Simulator is a virtual reality application designed to provide an immersive and practical experience in occupational health and safety (OHS) within welding environments. With over 100 work orders and more than 50 risk scenarios, this simulator enables users to identify, assess, and manage welding-related risks safely and effectively.

The application includes quick exercises that promote dynamic and hands-on learning, allowing users to enhance their skills in realistic environments without the dangers of a physical workshop. It is ideal for both beginners and professionals looking to strengthen their knowledge and safety protocols.

With immersive graphics and detailed scenarios, the simulator not only teaches the best OHS practices but also provides real-time evaluation to ensure users develop the necessary competencies to work safely in the field of welding.
